Response:
Logic behind the result row UOM defined in purchasing documents line items report

The UOM (Unit of Measure) defined in the result row of the Purchasing Documents - Line Items report is based on the equivalent measurements between the base UOM and the different process UOM. This allows for a clear understanding of the quantities associated with each purchasing document item. The report displays the purchasing document line items along with associated G/L accounts
